programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #20
programme.desc: 米娜尝试打造啫堡史上最惊人的千秋来取悦国王。不幸的是,这位年轻的科学家很快就发现,无论多么先进的技术,都无法取缔团队合作和友谊。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #21
programme.desc: 比路被委派一项非常重要的工作—负责管理音乐工厂!尽管女王留下了说明书,比路却无视它。她一去休息,整个运作就变得疯狂。可怜的渡渡鸟努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老板,灾难迫在眉睫。比路必须快速学习,准备工作是正确执行任何工作的关键!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #22
programme.desc: 莉塔厌倦了她玩的每场比赛都输掉,所以她用一些小气的手镯来助她必胜。尽管一开始她很开心,但却发现自己掉进一个危险的陷阱,并将使她成为一个失败者。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #23
programme.desc: 啫堡有麻烦了!它那奇妙的音乐泡泡充满了垃圾和黏糊糊的东西。经过调查整个星球,国王、王后和孩子们意识到泡泡里的垃圾正是他们的垃圾!他们齐心协力改变邋遢的习惯,让啫堡恢复啫喱般的健康。他们在过程中将垃圾回收成大家都能享用的东西。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #24
programme.desc: 多得一些突破性的科学,米娜能够让物体和她自己隐形!她看到隐形对她信任的朋友的影响!经过一天的疯狂事件后,孩子们发现了所有看不见的怪事的罪魁祸首。他们想出一个自己的实验,看看科学家有多喜欢接受测试!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #25
programme.desc: 啫堡从未经历过最惊人的事件之一即将发生。姑毛不想错过它。这就是为何他尝试向他的朋友隐瞒他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有无法掩饰的症状。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #26
programme.desc: 受到闪电和雷声的惊吓,比路和姑毛在音乐工厂寻求庇护。不过进去以后,他们才意识到将迎接更可怕的事;城堡里有个幽灵吓坏了渡渡鸟,阻止牠们制造音乐泡泡!如果渡渡鸟停下来,啫堡就没有音乐。而如果没有音乐,啫喱星就会冻结!哎呀!男孩们需要找到幽灵,击溃它并拯救永远充满音乐气息的啫堡!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #27
programme.desc: 国王不想与人分享他的新火箭驱动滑板,所以把它藏在一个魔法盒子里。姑毛和比路决定取得它,挑战国王的意愿,最终进入一个更大的新世界。一个充满乐趣和……危险的世界。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #28
programme.desc: 皇后心情不好。国王和孩子们同意举办有史以来最好的生日派对。不幸的是,每个参与者对于如何组织女王的惊喜派对都有个别非常特别的想法。它的成功将取决于他们「易地而处」的能力。尤其是女王。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #29
programme.desc: 比路厌倦了女王,他认为女王试图毁掉他所有的冒险和游戏。在满天流星的星夜,比路许下一个愿望: 愿女王变回少女,让他为所欲为。当比路的愿望成真,他将必须当个疯狂的小女王哥哥,并意识到这可能是很艰巨的任务,有时甚至很危险。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #30
programme.desc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒来发现珍爱的头盔不见了!最重要的是,他的朋友们表现得很奇怪,他们似乎都忘记了他的生日。姑毛很乐意让一切恢复正常。幸运的是,他收到一个惊喜,可以让这天成为一个非常特别的日子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #31
programme.desc: 安高在与比路和姑毛玩耍时弄伤了自己,因此必须在家休息几天。比路感到内疚,决定搬进安高的房子,直到他的朋友好转为止。他们对生活的不同看法相交,然后一起发现如果睁大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的细节,也可以很享受。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #32
programme.desc: 莉塔在米娜的实验室试做自己的实验。她很快就发现首先需要学习一些基础知识来避免灾难发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #33
programme.desc: 比路发现他最好的朋友有音乐天赋。从那一刻起,他将尝试与其他朋友分享发现。尽管姑毛很害羞,比路还是会尝试揭露和分享这个秘密。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #34
programme.desc: 姑毛弄丢了他用来和比路玩啫堡侠和头盔仔的眼镜。他们都发现一只戴著姑毛眼镜的瞎子渡渡鸟。戴上它后,渡渡鸟可以重见光明,并与其他渡渡鸟玩耍。姑毛会放弃他的眼镜,还是取回它去当超级英雄?

programme.desc: 法拉发现一颗未知的动物牙齿,并寻求游侠团协助将其归还给真正的主人。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #4
programme.desc: 嘉豪遇到一只正在挣扎的被困海豚!他寻求少年游侠团协助海豚重获自由。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #5
programme.desc: 萨利和法拉筑篝火过夜时偶遇一只马来亚幼虎,于是呼召少年游侠团助牠与母亲团聚。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #6
programme.desc: 凯怜悯受伤的螃蟹,他呼召少年游侠团帮助这只可怜的动物。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #7
programme.desc: 一场意外令凯的无人机坠入海床。他知道一头不知名的怪物劫持了那坠落的无人机后,就呼召少年游侠团。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #8
programme.desc: 萨利发现一只可能濒临绝种的黄胸织布鸟,这让少年游侠团们警戒起来,迅速动员采取行动,决心保护这鸟类免受伤害。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #9
programme.desc: 嘉豪并不知道与斧头鲨共泳有多险象横生,少年游侠团队用新升级的车辆极速去营救嘉豪。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #10
programme.desc: 凯的无人机测试发现了一个大熊猫的爪印,促使少年游侠团开展研究熊猫及其小宝宝的任务。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #11
programme.desc: 萨利知悉貘及其宝宝出乎意料地遭老虎狩猎,立即呼召少年游侠团。老虎的骚扰让貘宝宝在森林里迷路。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #12
programme.desc: 嘉豪发现椰子蟹将椰子从树顶掉下来,少年游侠团协助他清理海滩,使它变得更安全。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 2 #3
programme.desc: 国王刚刚调整了他的汽车,所以想让所有人都见到。这就是为何他组织了一场赛车比赛,啫堡上的所有车辆都将参加!甚至连莉塔和她的三轮车也参赛!比赛开始,国王不再自负,这说服孩子们需要联合起来,全力以赴赢得胜利!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 2 #4
programme.desc: 姑毛的旧运动鞋终于破了,女王送给他一双闪亮的新鞋。姑毛对新运动鞋那令人著迷的洁白感到非常惊讶,令他做不到任何事。问题是……如果你不能穿著波鞋跑过泥泞或用它们踢球,还要它来干嘛?姑毛是这么想的。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 2 #5
programme.desc: 莉塔和王后在神秘的「幻变森林」中散步时,发现了一只离家出走的小渡渡鸟,在这个陌生地方迷了路。在救援行动中,莉塔也迷路了。她需要运用自己的聪敏才能找到小渡渡鸟,并回到朋友身边。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 2 #6
programme.desc: 米娜的一项实验刺激到一只渡渡蝶,使其长得非常巨大。一开始,牠吓跑了啫堡上所有人,但渡渡蝶和孩子们很快就会经历一段美好而意想不到的友谊。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #19
programme.desc: 啫喱星颂扬音乐、乐趣和友谊。加入贝洛和他的朋友们的喜剧冒险之旅,学习在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音乐的起源)上和谐相处。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #20
programme.desc: 米娜尝试打造啫堡史上最惊人的千秋来取悦国王。不幸的是,这位年轻的科学家很快就发现,无论多么先进的技术,都无法取缔团队合作和友谊。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #21
programme.desc: 比路被委派一项非常重要的工作—负责管理音乐工厂!尽管女王留下了说明书,比路却无视它。她一去休息,整个运作就变得疯狂。可怜的渡渡鸟努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老板,灾难迫在眉睫。比路必须快速学习,准备工作是正确执行任何工作的关键!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #22
programme.desc: 莉塔厌倦了她玩的每场比赛都输掉,所以她用一些小气的手镯来助她必胜。尽管一开始她很开心,但却发现自己掉进一个危险的陷阱,并将使她成为一个失败者。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #23
programme.desc: 啫堡有麻烦了!它那奇妙的音乐泡泡充满了垃圾和黏糊糊的东西。经过调查整个星球,国王、王后和孩子们意识到泡泡里的垃圾正是他们的垃圾!他们齐心协力改变邋遢的习惯,让啫堡恢复啫喱般的健康。他们在过程中将垃圾回收成大家都能享用的东西。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #24
programme.desc: 多得一些突破性的科学,米娜能够让物体和她自己隐形!她看到隐形对她信任的朋友的影响!经过一天的疯狂事件后,孩子们发现了所有看不见的怪事的罪魁祸首。他们想出一个自己的实验,看看科学家有多喜欢接受测试!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #25
programme.desc: 啫堡从未经历过最惊人的事件之一即将发生。姑毛不想错过它。这就是为何他尝试向他的朋友隐瞒他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有无法掩饰的症状。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #26
programme.desc: 受到闪电和雷声的惊吓,比路和姑毛在音乐工厂寻求庇护。不过进去以后,他们才意识到将迎接更可怕的事;城堡里有个幽灵吓坏了渡渡鸟,阻止牠们制造音乐泡泡!如果渡渡鸟停下来,啫堡就没有音乐。而如果没有音乐,啫喱星就会冻结!哎呀!男孩们需要找到幽灵,击溃它并拯救永远充满音乐气息的啫堡!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #27
programme.desc: 国王不想与人分享他的新火箭驱动滑板,所以把它藏在一个魔法盒子里。姑毛和比路决定取得它,挑战国王的意愿,最终进入一个更大的新世界。一个充满乐趣和……危险的世界。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #28
programme.desc: 皇后心情不好。国王和孩子们同意举办有史以来最好的生日派对。不幸的是,每个参与者对于如何组织女王的惊喜派对都有个别非常特别的想法。它的成功将取决于他们「易地而处」的能力。尤其是女王。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #29
programme.desc: 比路厌倦了女王,他认为女王试图毁掉他所有的冒险和游戏。在满天流星的星夜,比路许下一个愿望: 愿女王变回少女,让他为所欲为。当比路的愿望成真,他将必须当个疯狂的小女王哥哥,并意识到这可能是很艰巨的任务,有时甚至很危险。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #30
programme.desc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒来发现珍爱的头盔不见了!最重要的是,他的朋友们表现得很奇怪,他们似乎都忘记了他的生日。姑毛很乐意让一切恢复正常。幸运的是,他收到一个惊喜,可以让这天成为一个非常特别的日子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #31
programme.desc: 安高在与比路和姑毛玩耍时弄伤了自己,因此必须在家休息几天。比路感到内疚,决定搬进安高的房子,直到他的朋友好转为止。他们对生活的不同看法相交,然后一起发现如果睁大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的细节,也可以很享受。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #32
programme.desc: 莉塔在米娜的实验室试做自己的实验。她很快就发现首先需要学习一些基础知识来避免灾难发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #33
programme.desc: 比路发现他最好的朋友有音乐天赋。从那一刻起,他将尝试与其他朋友分享发现。尽管姑毛很害羞,比路还是会尝试揭露和分享这个秘密。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #34
programme.desc: 姑毛弄丢了他用来和比路玩啫堡侠和头盔仔的眼镜。他们都发现一只戴著姑毛眼镜的瞎子渡渡鸟。戴上它后,渡渡鸟可以重见光明,并与其他渡渡鸟玩耍。姑毛会放弃他的眼镜,还是取回它去当超级英雄?

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #1
programme.desc: 水花带牠的朋友去看探望朋友阿Lu/ 章鱼浪花喜欢礁镇的乐韵。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #2
programme.desc: 水花被一条牠想交朋友的鱼忽视/ 七彩麒麟芬尼加入一起玩。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #3
programme.desc: 水花、宝泡和阿灯遇到自封为森林游侠的奇普/ 宝泡的鳍受伤并无法游泳。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #4
programme.desc: 阿灯的朋友发现他制作美丽的沙画/ 阿波带领同伴调查海龙的传说。

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #25
programme.desc: 阿米尔王子有一只新宠物鸟,但牠有点不妥。牠不能飞!在尝试各种方法帮牠飞后,孩子们对牠有了惊人发现。

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #26
programme.desc: 孩子们在红胡子想挖的藏宝处建造沙堡,结果会如何?谁会得偿所愿?

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #27
programme.desc: 孩子们协助新的交通督导员香蕉树先生工作。但如他变得太擅长自己的工作会怎样呢?看看结果如何!

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #28
programme.desc: 一些螃蟹付钱给红胡子来观看一场壮观的马戏表演。不过,因为莫里士不是最伟大的表演者,所以螃蟹十分生气!孩子们能帮忙拯救这场表演吗?

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #29
programme.desc: 阿添所有的魔术把戏都失效了。一定是他的魔杖坏了!小孩们前往沙漠寻找新魔杖,但最终得到了比他们想像更强大的东西。

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #30
programme.desc: 宝拉的邮递服务有了第一位付费客户!宝拉和她的团队在运送包裹时遇上麻烦。他们将如何确保成功交付呢?

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #31
programme.desc: 孩子们和莫里士试图让红胡子在拍照时微笑,但似乎没有甚么成效。甚么能让红胡子微笑呢?

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #32
programme.desc: 红胡子卖广告招募新的海盗助手,并承诺给最好的助手提供一辆帅气的电单车。阿添和凿奇非常想得到电单车,并争相取悦红胡子,因而牺牲他们的友谊,这样值得吗?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #9
programme.desc: 一场雷暴摧毁了猩猩的巢穴。牠由于手臂受伤,在地面上很容易因各种危险而受伤。少年游侠必须在饥饿的掠食者出现前帮牠重建巢穴!

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #10
programme.desc: 一只乌鸦俯冲而下,抢走了萨利家的钥匙。里奥、姬蒂和英雄前去帮助萨利取回它,但狡猾的乌鸦每次都智取他们。游侠要怎么做才能拿回钥匙?

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #11
programme.desc: 少年游侠遇到一只正经历低谷的湾鳄。对这只可怜的爬虫类来说,似乎诸事不宜。当牠在一天中遇到各种问题,少年游侠就会伸出援手。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #12
programme.desc: 臭鼩一家要逃离一只饥饿的掠食者,少年游侠沿途帮助牠们克服障碍。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #13
programme.desc: 萨利的植物上有一只看似外星人的昆虫。少年游侠必须把牠带到安全的地方,免牠在脱壳后受伤。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #14
programme.desc: 少年游侠在森林里发现了一只没有鹿角的小鹿。出于安全考量,游侠尝试保护牠不受伤害。不过,他们很快就发现牠还有其他手段自保。留意观看它们到底是甚么!

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #15
programme.desc: 萨利发现一只小鸟被困树上,而牠的同伴却不见踪影。少年游侠兵分两路执行任务: 一组留下来从掠食者手中保护树上的小鸟,另一组则去搜救失踪同伴。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥新加坡外传 第2季 #16
programme.desc: 少年游侠遇到一种可以在逃避掠食者时将尾巴与身体分离的动物。但他们必须从肥皂灾难中把牠拯救出来免牠受伤。

programme.desc: ZooMoo小队进行一场关于住在寒冷地方的动物的问答游戏。

programme.title: 蜘蛛小姐 #37
programme.desc: 日食的阴影降临阳光派,虫子们享受这场天文现象- 除了蹦士,牠担心如果缺乏自己的帮助,太阳就不会从藏身处出来。/史角和蹦士犹豫是否要让雪莉和史汀奇参加牠们的捉迷藏。与一只行动缓慢的蜗牛和一只超臭的臭屁虫捉迷藏太容易了。但事与愿违,虫子们采用史汀奇的推论技巧,游戏正式开始!

programme.title: 蜘蛛小姐 #38
programme.desc: 在一次参观捕蝇草维纳斯的实地考察中,螳螂先生讲述「螳螂大师」的传奇故事,帮虫子们了解如何在食虫植物附近保持安全。/螳螂先生建议学生大肆庆祝「拥抱虫子日」,韦高和蹦士决定不了想在这特别日子扮演甚么虫子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #19
programme.desc: 啫喱星颂扬音乐、乐趣和友谊。加入贝洛和他的朋友们的喜剧冒险之旅,学习在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音乐的起源)上和谐相处。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #20
programme.desc: 米娜尝试打造啫堡史上最惊人的千秋来取悦国王。不幸的是,这位年轻的科学家很快就发现,无论多么先进的技术,都无法取缔团队合作和友谊。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #21
programme.desc: 比路被委派一项非常重要的工作—负责管理音乐工厂!尽管女王留下了说明书,比路却无视它。她一去休息,整个运作就变得疯狂。可怜的渡渡鸟努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老板,灾难迫在眉睫。比路必须快速学习,准备工作是正确执行任何工作的关键!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #22
programme.desc: 莉塔厌倦了她玩的每场比赛都输掉,所以她用一些小气的手镯来助她必胜。尽管一开始她很开心,但却发现自己掉进一个危险的陷阱,并将使她成为一个失败者。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #23
programme.desc: 啫堡有麻烦了!它那奇妙的音乐泡泡充满了垃圾和黏糊糊的东西。经过调查整个星球,国王、王后和孩子们意识到泡泡里的垃圾正是他们的垃圾!他们齐心协力改变邋遢的习惯,让啫堡恢复啫喱般的健康。他们在过程中将垃圾回收成大家都能享用的东西。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #24
programme.desc: 多得一些突破性的科学,米娜能够让物体和她自己隐形!她看到隐形对她信任的朋友的影响!经过一天的疯狂事件后,孩子们发现了所有看不见的怪事的罪魁祸首。他们想出一个自己的实验,看看科学家有多喜欢接受测试!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #25
programme.desc: 啫堡从未经历过最惊人的事件之一即将发生。姑毛不想错过它。这就是为何他尝试向他的朋友隐瞒他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有无法掩饰的症状。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #26
programme.desc: 受到闪电和雷声的惊吓,比路和姑毛在音乐工厂寻求庇护。不过进去以后,他们才意识到将迎接更可怕的事;城堡里有个幽灵吓坏了渡渡鸟,阻止牠们制造音乐泡泡!如果渡渡鸟停下来,啫堡就没有音乐。而如果没有音乐,啫喱星就会冻结!哎呀!男孩们需要找到幽灵,击溃它并拯救永远充满音乐气息的啫堡!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #27
programme.desc: 国王不想与人分享他的新火箭驱动滑板,所以把它藏在一个魔法盒子里。姑毛和比路决定取得它,挑战国王的意愿,最终进入一个更大的新世界。一个充满乐趣和……危险的世界。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #28
programme.desc: 皇后心情不好。国王和孩子们同意举办有史以来最好的生日派对。不幸的是,每个参与者对于如何组织女王的惊喜派对都有个别非常特别的想法。它的成功将取决于他们「易地而处」的能力。尤其是女王。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #29
programme.desc: 比路厌倦了女王,他认为女王试图毁掉他所有的冒险和游戏。在满天流星的星夜,比路许下一个愿望: 愿女王变回少女,让他为所欲为。当比路的愿望成真,他将必须当个疯狂的小女王哥哥,并意识到这可能是很艰巨的任务,有时甚至很危险。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #30
programme.desc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒来发现珍爱的头盔不见了!最重要的是,他的朋友们表现得很奇怪,他们似乎都忘记了他的生日。姑毛很乐意让一切恢复正常。幸运的是,他收到一个惊喜,可以让这天成为一个非常特别的日子。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐: 粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复其自然多样性!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #36
programme.desc: 姑毛和莉塔正在户外度过愉快的一天,突然发现一颗渡渡鸟蛋。孩子们和小鸡蛋将进行动作连场的冒险。经过这么多的喧嚣,鸟蛋能存活下来吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #37
programme.desc: 音盘已经疯了,啫堡中的所有声音都被改变,造成了巨大的混乱。比路和莉塔将负责将每一个声音归还到它所属的地方。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #38
programme.desc: 比路必须戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮丧。幸运的是,他的朋友们用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何问题都可以变成有趣的事情。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #39
programme.desc: 姑毛决定穿上一双神奇的运动鞋走10万步,这将带他找到一个神奇的宝藏。至少他坚信如此,而他的朋友们则认为他疯了。最后,谁会赢?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #40
programme.desc: 特工需要甚么?我们可以用日常物品创造出哪些惊人的发明?米娜有答案。她很快就会向她的朋友们证明科学不一定无聊。事实上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳资源。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #41
programme.desc: 孩子们参加捉伊人比赛,看谁是宇宙中最强队伍。那么,这有甚么问题呢?即使他们不在比赛时,也开始将其他队员视为敌人。必须有人教他们竞争和敌对的分别。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #42
programme.desc: 国王迫不及待地想试用他的新品: 一个会随著音乐飞舞的浴缸。当国王暂时离开时,比路和米娜最终成为第一个尝试的人。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #43
programme.desc: 比路突然拥有了强大的力量,这要归功于一枚满足他所有愿望的警长星章。他的新责任赋予了他如此多的力量,令比路最终希望得到很快就会后悔的东西。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #44
programme.desc: 国王伤了背部。每个人都想出一个计划,把他安然无恙地送回城堡里舒适的床上。他们必须学会倾听对方的意见,甚至考虑最荒谬的选择,因为你永远不知道答案在哪里。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #45
programme.desc: 姑毛必须担任舞蹈比赛的评委。起初,这个决定似乎很容易,但当他发现选择赢家就意味著选择输家时……事情变得复杂!他会失去他淘汰的朋友吗?那样重的责任会令他感觉怎样?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #46
programme.desc: 今天是孩子们相聚并画画的好日子,他们都兴奋地开始。比路知道他的画是女王的最爱,他迫不及待地想给她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些东西。比路认为这不公平。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #47
programme.desc: 白色渡渡鸟突然造访孩子们。他们所有人,尤其是安高,都与这种不可思议的动物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鸟有一个任务在身,分别似乎无可避免。尽管悲伤地告别,但总有音乐让他们振作起来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #48
programme.desc: 米娜读完智者伊朵罗的传记后,惊讶万分。对她来说,没有甚么比智慧更重要。这就是为何她会避免发问,以免暴露她的无知。令她吃惊的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就会明白不耻下问的重要性。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #49
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛梦想成为真正的超级英雄,所以他们请米娜训练他们。她恰如其分,只是比路还没有准备好忍受漫长而艰苦的训练。他放弃并选择了一项更容易的活动。那是他以后会后悔的事。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #50
programme.desc: 当其他人都得到赞扬和掌声时,要站著面对并不总是那么容易。比路尝试在他朋友的表演中抢尽风头,让他们非常沮丧,比路需要分享他的一些才能来解决问题。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #5
programme.desc: 孩子们在沙堆里发现了一颗牙齿,并想物归原主/ 水花和朋友们在珊瑚礁竞赛。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #6
programme.desc: 其他人发现阿灯嘴里有寄生虫,都警戒起来/ 阿波听到一条跨越海洋的奇怪讯息。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #7
programme.desc: 孩子们不相信以前吉殊速度很快/ 阿灯的「小表弟」毛仔到访,牠是一只巨大的翻车鱼。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #8
programme.desc: 阿灯厌倦总是成为「紧张的朋友」/ 水花、阿灯和泡宝跟泰迪一起担当海带之森护林员一天。

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #33

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #34
programme.desc: 黄氏兄弟、苏美和小孩们进行一场史诗式的运动大战。女孩们会玩空手道,男孩们会玩体操。最后到底谁胜谁负?

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #35

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #36
programme.desc: 小孩们未经许可进入太空船的一间房,令一个外星人成功逃走。他们必须在太空人先生发现前找到外星人,并将牠送回原先的房间。不过,这外星人真的很善于躲藏!

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #37

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #38

programme.title: 宝拉数一数 5 #40

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #2
programme.desc: 法拉偶然发现一双被困在井里的母狮和她的幼狮。在游侠的帮助下,他们需要想方设法来帮牠们摆脱困境。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #3
programme.desc: 法拉发现一颗未知的动物牙齿,并寻求游侠团协助将其归还给真正的主人。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #4
programme.desc: 嘉豪遇到一只正在挣扎的被困海豚!他寻求少年游侠团协助海豚重获自由。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #5
programme.desc: 萨利和法拉筑篝火过夜时偶遇一只马来亚幼虎,于是呼召少年游侠团助牠与母亲团聚。

programme.title: 野生游侠里奥 第3季 #6
programme.desc: 凯怜悯受伤的螃蟹,他呼召少年游侠团帮助这只可怜的动物。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #5
programme.desc: 孩子们在沙堆里发现了一颗牙齿,并想物归原主/ 水花和朋友们在珊瑚礁竞赛。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #6
programme.desc: 其他人发现阿灯嘴里有寄生虫,都警戒起来/ 阿波听到一条跨越海洋的奇怪讯息。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #7
programme.desc: 孩子们不相信以前吉殊速度很快/ 阿灯的「小表弟」毛仔到访,牠是一只巨大的翻车鱼。

programme.title: 水花与泡宝 #8
programme.desc: 阿灯厌倦总是成为「紧张的朋友」/ 水花、阿灯和泡宝跟泰迪一起担当海带之森护林员一天。

In this show, the audience can enjoy the natural and cultural backgrounds of Chinese traditional villages, and will find their knowledge of this oriental country expand through the interviews of Chinese people overseas whose memory and nostalgia can also reveal the very core value of the Chinese traditional culture.

programme.title: Walking around China
programme.desc: It focuses on the latest changes in China from a humanistic perspective, pays attention to new phenomena, new fashions, and new things around ordinary Chinese people,

programme.title: Across the Strait
programme.desc: The Across the Strait traces the much-discussed issues across the Strait, reflects the will of the citizens on two sides of the Strait and details the Chinese Government's policy of “one country, two systems” in a bid to enhance the Taiwan fellowmen's understanding of the Mainland China.

programme.title: Asia Today
programme.desc: Report the Asia News on Asian view

programme.title: China News
programme.desc: It concentrates on the latest news and social changes happening in china and all over the world

programme.title: Focus Today
programme.desc: Traces the current affairs from china and the world

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Ma's unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: Chen Zhen (Donnie Yen) vanished and was supposedly dead. He actually left China and joined the Allied war effort on the European battlefields. While China is traumatized by military cliques during the Warlord Era in the 1920s, Japan has grown into the most powerful foreign national group there in Shanghai. Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai in the guise of a young entrepreneur in order to infiltrate Club Casablanca, whose owner Tycoon Liu (Anthony Wong) is suspected of collusion with the Japanese. He soon wins the trust of Liu while falling in love with the gorgeous club singer Kiki (Shu Qi). Meanwhile, Japanese general Chikaraishi (Kohata Ryu) comes to Shanghai with his assassination squad, subjecting the city to his reign of terror. Donning a black mask to avoid exposing his real identity, Chen Zhen secretly works with police captain Huang (Huang Bo) to protect the Chinese patriots from the Japanese assassins, as the hope of a nation rests on his deadly fists...

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Struggling with Alzheimer's disease, Hong Kong film buff Kim relies on his brother to manage their appliance repair shop. Kim's quirky behaviour prompts producer Ginger to suspect that he may be a film critic trying to profit from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger uncovers Kim's secrets and sorrows as she gets closer to him and his family.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father's heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owner's deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brother's death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to “save lives with speed”. Meanwhile, the truth about his brother's accident emerges with the investigation of Le's three good friends...

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about the abuse of residents in an Elderly and Disabled Care Home. To expose the home's wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity and unveil the cruel truth under broad daylight.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: The Way We Dance
programme.desc: Tofu shop girl Fleur possesses a quirky gift for hip hop and dance which she uses to becomes a supernova in the university dance crew. Meanwhile, Alan, from the Tai Chi Club has an eye for Fleur's sleight of hand and tries to recruit her into his club.

programme.title: Quan Dao: The Journey of a Boxer
programme.desc: Ah Niu learns boxing from Uncle Xing, the boss of a boxing studio, since young and uses his skills to help the weak fight villains. When Xing's son attempts drug trafficking to save his father's studio but fails and is brutally beaten up, Ah Niu accepts a death combat challenge so as to help him take revenge.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An emergency occurs on an offshore drilling rig that would cause it to capsize and sink. The Emergency Response Unit races against the clock in a chopper rescue mission amidst dangerous explosions and fire. Captain Gao Qian must work seamlessly with his chopper pilot Zhao Cheng to rescue survivors using the most maverick and dangerous tactics.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk and Chief Inspector Lau both hit a dead end when investigating their respective bribery and money laundering cases. When Luk is accused of bribery after being framed by the money launderers, he risks everything he has to find crucial evidence against them to clear his name.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killer's mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened…

Di dusun Yana bertemu Rinah iblis yang mendiami rumah tersebut. Rinah bagitahu Yana kalau dia boleh kembalikan anak yana yang mati. Yana lakukan ritual dan Naily benar-benar kembali. programme.desc: As the countdown to the Eternal Night approaches, Jim is enlightened in the truth about himself.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia
programme.desc: When Jim's friends discover the Trollhunter has gone through a transformation, Jim will test his newly gained abilities.

programme.title: Istanbul Aku Datang
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda dari Malaysia pergi ke Istanbul untuk bertemu dengan teman lelaki kesayangannya, namun gadis yang naif itu tidak tahu apa yang akan berlaku kepada kehidupannya di sana.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Jodoh Tak Salah Alamat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luqman pernah mengenali seorang gadis bernama Diana ketika Diana melanggar keretanya dahulu. Diana berpenampilan seksi dan mengamalkan cara hidup barat membuatkan Luqman bersangka buruk terhadap Diana. Satu hari, Luqman ke masjid dan terserempak dengan seorang gadis cantik iaitu Adawiyah. Tanpa mengetahui, Adawiyah dan Diana adalah orang yang sama. Diana pernah terlibat dengan kemalangan dan sejak itu hidupnya berubah sepenuhnya.

programme.title: Dunia Baru The Movie
programme.desc: Filem ini bermula apabila Opie menemui sepucuk surat daripada Anizah yang menyatakan bahawa dia ingin berkahwin dengan teman lelakinya, Fazley, dan telah menguburkan impiannya untuk menyambung pelajaran ke UK.

programme.title: Hayya 1: The Power Of Love
programme.desc: Rahmat, wartawan yang dihantui dosa silam, berhijrah jadi relawan di kem pelarian Palestin dan bertemu Hayya, anak yatim piatu. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidupnya, namun bila dia pulang ke Indonesia untuk berkahwin dengan Yasna, tercetus konflik emosi yang rumit, lucu dan tegang antara mereka.

programme.title: Hayya 2: Dream Hope And Reality
programme.desc: Filem sekuel ini menyorot trauma dan kehilangan. Hayya melarikan diri ke Indonesia lalu bertemu Lia dan Faisal, yang akhirnya menganggapnya sebagai pengikat rumah tangga mereka. Sementara Rahmat, Adhin dan Ricis terus mencarinya, rahsia keluarga Faisal terbongkar hingga tragedi besar berlaku.

programme.title: 99 Nama Cinta
programme.desc: Kisah seorang penulis gosip terkenal yang bertemu lelaki berprinsip agama, lalu pertemuan itu mengubah cara hidup, pemikiran dan makna cinta dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Peluang Ketiga
programme.desc: Zulaikha dan Yusuf telah menjalinkan hubungan sejak zaman universiti lagi. Namun, hubungan mereka terputus apabila Yusuf tidak bersetuju dengan keputusan Zulaikha untuk menjadi seorang penyanyi. Zulaikha kemudian bertemu dengan Mikhail, seorang lelaki berhati mulia yang sentiasa menyokong segala impiannya. Sementara itu, Yusuf meneruskan kerjayanya sebagai pelumba basikal profesional dan jatuh cinta dengan seorang wartawan sukan bernama Alya.Namun, apabila Mikhail melamar Zulaikha, hati Yusuf mula dilanda cemburu. Mampukah Yusuf melupakan Zulaikha dan menerima hakikat bahawa cinta mereka mungkin sudah berlalu?

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna, usahawan berjaya yang ditipu tunangnya, Razi. Dia kecewa apabila perniagaan yang mereka usahakan rugi kerana Razi terbabit dengan skandal wang serta mempunyai perempuan simpanan. Sementara itu, Gie pula baru saja dibuang kerja. Walaupun masih mencari kerja, dia sangat tenang dan tetap ceria. Gie reda dengan situasi menimpanya.

programme.title: Love Supermoon
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki dan seorang wanita yang menjalani kehidupan masing-masing tetapi sering bertemu di majlis perkahwinan atau parti yang dianjurkan oleh rakan-rakan mereka. Mereka hanya mengenali antara satu sama lain melalui gosip yang didengar, namun berpura-pura tidak mengenali setiap kali bertemu.

programme.title: Magika
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua beradik, Ayu dan Malik, yang secara tidak sengaja masuk ke dunia ajaib bernama Magika ketika cuba menyelamatkan roh ibu mereka. Di dunia itu, mereka bertemu watak-watak dongeng Melayu seperti Nenek Kebayan dan Badang, sambil berjuang mencari jalan pulang ke dunia nyata.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Syawal Mencari Cinta
programme.desc: Pada pagi Raya, Syawal melepak bersama rakannya dan mereka tidak menunaikan solat sunat Hari Raya. Setelah selesai solat sunat Hari Raya, dia ternampak seorang gadis yang tidak pernah dilihatnya di kampung sebelum ini. Syawal terus berkesimpulan bahawa dia telah menemui cinta sejati. Dia telah mengunjung setiap rumah di kampung untuk menjejaki gadis tersebut. Selepas sekian lama mencari tanpa membuahkan hasil, Syawal terus mengumumkan kepada seluruh kampung bahawa dia akan melaksanakan rumah terbuka untuk hari raya dan semua orang dijemput hadir ke rumahnya. Namun demikian, setelah selesai rumah terbukanya, gadis yang dicari-cari Syawal masih tidak kelihatan. Dia kecewa lalu berputus asa. Tanpa sedar, gadis yang dijejaki selama ini adalah Cinta, sepupunya sendiri.

programme.title: Kaki Kitai
programme.desc: Din AKA Drango dan Ayoi adalah dua sahabat yang juga merupakan penipu. Mereka berdua datang ke Kuala Lumpur dan secara tidak sengaja bertemu semula dengan seorang kawan lama yang kini bekerja sebagai pegawai polis. Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: Top Chef
programme.desc: With only six chefs remaining, the challenges get even more difficult, when pastry super-chef Sherry Yard awaits the All Stars for a dreaded dessert Quickfire, made even more impossible when chefs must endure a blindfolded taste test to pick their ingredients. Then Michelin-starred Chefs/Restaurateurs Niki and Carole Lidi-Nakayama demonstrate a traditional Japanese Kaiseki meal, the ultimate in simplicity, restraint and precision. The chefs must make this formidable dinner for not just these Kaiseki masters, but in celebration of the Tokyo games with Olympic medalists Diana Taurasi, Rai Benjamin, Nastia Liukin, Ibtihaj Muhammad, Christian Coleman, Kerri Walsh Jennings and NBC Olympic Primetime Host Mike Tirico. The gold medal meal takes place at the iconic Los Angeles Coliseum with Padma, Tom, Nilou Motamed and Niki & Carole Lidi-Nakayama at the judges table.

Perkongsian yang santai dan pembukaan dimulakan dengan Q&A yang menjurus kepada permasalahan, kemusykilan harian yang dihadapi.Ustaz juga akan meminta adik-adik tersebut mengaji surah tersebut dan membetulkan bacaan mana yang salah. Ustaz juga akan mengupas kegunaan serta kebaikan surah tersebut dan akan ada soal jawab bersama adik-adik tersebut.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “3 Amalan Sunnah Sebelum Tidur”. Bersama Ustaz Hafiz yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Hidayah Klip
programme.desc: Episod kali ini, menemu bual seorang artis antarabangsa Maher Zain yang popular dengan lagu Insy-Allah. Maher Zain mengeluarkan single terbaru beliau yang bertajuk The Power yang berkonsepkan ketuhanan yang menyentuh kehebatan mereka yang sentiasa berzikir mengingati Allah. Penulis liriknya Moh Denebi dan Maher Zain sendiri. Penulis lirik untuk bahasa inggeris iaitu Bara Kherigi dan Paddy Dalton. Maher Zain mendapat inspirasi sepenuhnya daripada Al-Quran.

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Mustafa
programme.desc: Ammar semakin rapat dengan Mustafa dan tidak lagi takut dengan Mustafa. Comel kawan kepada Ammar seringkali berkepit dengan Ammar kerana dia sukakan Ammar akan tetapi Ammar rimas dengan Comel yang asyik hendak berkepit dengannya.

programme.title: Tim Mama
programme.desc: Amer gembira melihat perubahan positif pada mamanya selepas mula berbalas mesej dengan Sam. Lalu Amer minta Syaiful sarankan kepada Nina agar pergi mencari kerja. Ternyata saranan 'Sam' itu membuatkan Nina kembali muram. Rupanya Nina tak yakin dia masih mampu untuk bersaing dengan calon yang lebih muda di dalam merebut peluang pekerjaan.

programme.title: Aura Bintang
programme.desc: Aura bintang membawakan kisah selebriti khususnya yang mejurus kepada perubahan positif yang wujud setelah mereka berhijrah. Rancangan ini merangkumi 4 segmen iaitu hijrah, addin, islam dan kifayah. Episod kali ini Dayah Bakar akan membawa penonton menemu bual dengan Adam Corrie.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Honest Work”. Bersama Ustaz Erfino yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Bacaan Al-quran V1
programme.desc: Bacaan ayat suci Al Quran

programme.title: Salam Nusantara Pulau Jawa
programme.desc: Pada episod kali ini Salam Nusantara Pulau Jawa mengupas tentang pesantren-pesantren atau lebih mudah dikenali sebagai sekolah pondok. Tasik Malaya terletak di 120km ke timur Bandung ibu kota jawa barat. Selain mempunyai perniagaan anyaman dan penuh dengan budaya tradisi sunda, tempat ini juga ramai dikunjungi kerana pesantrennya yang bagus.

programme.title: Negeri Yang Hilang Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Negeri Sarawak yang kini lahir dari kerajan melayu awal yang hilang dalam lipatan Sejarah. Bersama Datu Dr. Haji Sanib yang merupakan sejarawan pakar sejarah Sarawak yang akan menjejak sejarah negeri Sarawak. Episod kali ini kita akan menjejaki “Negeri Kalaka”.

programme.title: Syukurlah
programme.desc: Syukurlah memaparkan perkongsian cerita peribadi yang mampu memberi inspirasi serta mengupas topik-topik semasa bersama artis jemputan dalam setiap episod. Episod minggu ini kita akan dengarkan perkongsian daripada Norman Hakim dan Abby Abadi.

programme.title: Fail Harta Pusaka
programme.desc: Episod kali ini membawa tajuk "Dikikis Suami Baru". Fail Harta Pusaka merupakan sebuah rancangan Doku Drama yang mengetengahkan seorang Pakar Perancangan Harta, Ketua Hakim, dan Panel Penasihat Syariah berpengalaman dalam pembahagian harta pusaka melalui HIBAH. Setiap episod akan mengupas isu-isu semasa yang dihadapi masyarakat, disampaikan dalam suasana santai dengan disertai lakonan semula.

programme.title: Khurafat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjanjian terlarang dan salah satu bentuk penyelewengan dalam aqidah Islam diantara manusia dan syaitan, sesuatu yang amat ditegah dalam agama suci kita. Tetapi, manusia tanpa mengira akibat membelakangkan Allah, disokong dengan nafsu dendam serakah akhirnya hanyut dengan bisikan syaitan.

programme.title: Doa
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan doa mengenai “Doa Pengikat Kasih”. Doa akan membicarakan mengenai doa-doa yang dapat kita gunakan dalam seharian kita bukan sahaja doa selepas solat tetapi solat yang boleh kita amalkan agar terselamat di dunia dan akhirat.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V1
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Kerugian Besar” Bersama Dai Syafiqah yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Inikah Dikatakan Cinta
programme.desc: Mia mengadu pada Ustazah Iman, rakan lamanya di universiti. Ustazah Iman yang merupakan pensyarah perundangan di sebuah universiti mahu Mia menganggap semua ini sebagai ujian dari Allah. Sebagai rakan yang kenal Mia sejak dari zaman gelap Mia lagi, Ustazah Iman tidak mahu kejadian kini melunturkan semangat Mia. Ustazah Iman mencadangkan Mia memakai tudung untuk mengelakkan fitnah. Ustazah Iman menghadiahkan beberapa helai tudung kepada Mia.

programme.title: Tersungkur Di Kaki Mahligai
programme.desc: Disebabkan kemalangan, Afendi tidak dapat bergerak dan dijaga oleh Shahira. Jazlan pula yang suka kepada Shahira cuba untuk membeli jiwa Shahira dan pada masa yang sama hendak mendapatkan wang insuran Afendi. Apabila tidak dilayan oleh Shahira, Shazlan cuba merogol Shahira namun sempat diselamatkan oleh Afendi yang telah pulih dari kemalangan tersebut.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah “Jangan Bersedih”. Bersama Dai Danial yang akan mengupas topik ini lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil masih memancing di kolam renang rumah mewah itu, Qistina mendapat panggilan untuk membawa Jamil ke rancangan radio. Qistina jadi buntu untuk memujuk Jamil daripada berhenti memancing di kolam renang itu. Jamil mengatakan dia tidak pernah berputus asa dalam mencari rezeki untuk dimakan, hal itu membuatkan Qistina terdesak untuk menipu Jamil. Sebenarnya Qistina ini seorang mata duitan dan pandai mengambil kesempatan. Melihat dari perwatakan Jamil yang lurus bendul, Qistina segera mengambil kesempatan yang kononnya nampak mahu membantu Jamil sedangkan segala wang Jamil Qistina akan simpan di dalam poketnya sendiri.

programme.title: Sahabat Sahabat Nabi
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membicarakan mengenai sahabat nabi iaitu Abu Ubaidah Al-Jarrah r.a. Umat Islam yang dikenali sahabat nabi dianggap mempunyai hubungan terus dengan Nabi Muhammad s.a.w dan mereka bukanlah pendusta atau menentang ajaran Islam. Jika meraka melihatnya, mendengarnya, atau berada di hadapan baginda walau sekejap mereka dianggap sebagai sahabat nabi s.a.w.

programme.title: Religious Clip
programme.desc: Dalam episod kali ini, topik yang di sampaikan ialah "Hidup Dengan Sabar”. Bersama Dai Fuad yang akan membincangkan topik ini dengan lebih lanjut lagi.

programme.title: Puji Pujian & Kalam Allah V2
programme.desc: Zikir dan bacaan surah-surah lazim.

programme.title: Jom Tanya & Bertarannum
programme.desc: Dalam episod ini topik yang akan dibincangkan mengenai permasalahan tentang anak yang degil & ustaz memberikan satu doa supaya anak mendengar kata ibubapa serta ustaz akan mengajar para pelajar mengaji surah ash-sharh / al-insyirah dalam taranum sikah.

programme.title: Doa
programme.desc: Episod ini akan membincangkan doa mengenai “Doa Pagi dan Petang”. Doa akan membicarakan mengenai doa-doa yang dapat kita gunakan dalam seharian kita bukan sahaja doa selepas solat tetapi solat yang boleh kita amalkan agar terselamat di dunia dan akhirat.

programme.title: Khurafat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjanjian terlarang dan salah satu bentuk penyelewengan dalam aqidah Islam diantara manusia dan syaitan, sesuatu yang amat ditegah dalam agama suci kita. Tetapi, manusia tanpa mengira akibat membelakangkan Allah, disokong dengan nafsu dendam serakah akhirnya hanyut dengan bisikan syaitan.

programme.title: Jom Jalan
programme.desc: Jom Jalan akan membawa Selebriti tanah air ke serata pelusuk tanah air. Pada setiap episod Selebriti akan membawa penonton ke destinasi menarik yang meliputi lokasi percutian, lokasi bersejarah, membeli belah dan makanan tempatan. Pada minggu ni Jom Jalan membawa penonton ke negeri Negeri Sembilan.

programme.title: Aku Hanya Ingin Dicintai
programme.desc: Maya meyakinkan Hilda dan Vishnu bahawa dia tidak boleh "dibeli" dengan wang. Vishnu yang mulanya kecewa dengan penolakan Maya, diam-diam melihat sisi lain Maya. Bagaimanapun, sikap Maya yang tegas dalam berpegang kepada prinsip hidupnya membawanya kepada bahaya yang lebih besar. Andre yang ingin menawan hati Vishnu menggunakan kaedah kasar untuk menyingkirkan Maya. Ia bukan sekadar kaedah kasar, Andre nampaknya mengambil jalan yang gelap dan kejam untuk memenuhi keinginannya.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Jamil mengejar seorang wanita kerana hendak memberitahu bahawa terdapat kertas terselit di bawah kasutnya. Tanpa diduga dia menjadi seorang model pula. Disebabkan Jamil viral kerana menolong seorang wanita tempoh hari dia semakin terkenal dan dikenali ramai orang sehingga dia dikejar dengan orang ramai.

programme.title: Khurafat
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjanjian terlarang dan salah satu bentuk penyelewengan dalam aqidah Islam diantara manusia dan syaitan, sesuatu yang amat ditegah dalam agama suci kita. Tetapi, manusia tanpa mengira akibat membelakangkan Allah, disokong dengan nafsu dendam serakah akhirnya hanyut dengan bisikan syaitan.

programme.title: Celebs Day Off
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda juga akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan episod kali ini, Fikry Ibrahim.

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Salamiah Hassan
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Salamiah Hassan berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.title: Sudirman Chow Kit Road
programme.desc: Sudirman Chow Kit Road! merupakan sebuah dokumentari yang mengupas perjalanan dan kenangan nostalgia seorang lelaki berbadan kecil tetapi mempunyai jiwa yang besar, Sudirman Haji Arshad untuk mengadakan konsert percuma yang menyatukan rakyat malaysia berbilang kaum di tengah tengah jalan Chow Kit dan ianya merupakan satu fenomena besar suatu ketika dahulu, sehinggakan ianya masih terpahat di hati rakyat Malaysia

programme.title: Terbaik Dari Jalanan
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke Sate 7 Pagi, Nasi Kukus Nasi Kerabu Cikgu Jani, Putu Bambu Raihana dan Delicious Shawarma.

programme.title: Deko Bajet
programme.desc: Dengan bajet sebanyak RM2,000 sahaja,, pereka bentuk dalaman Janna Baha selaku pengacara akan menghias semula ruang bilik tidur milik Fatiha di sebuah Pangsapur di Seri Kembangan.

programme.title: Cruise Cinta Lebaran
programme.desc: Aida Maria, yang baru putus cinta, memutuskan bercuti menaiki kapal mewah (“cruise”) ketika Ramadan. Di situ dia berkenalan dengan Maizal Hairi. Mereka rapat sepanjang perjalanan. Maizal memujuk Aida pulang beraya bersama keluarga. Selepas Aida sampai rumah, Maizal turut hadir beraya. Rupanya itu sebahagian dari perancangan neneknya untuk memperkenalkan mereka.

programme.title: Pembancuh Kopi Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Nuzul mogok seminggu dan layanannya pada Irsyad juga acuh tidak acuh. Pada suatu petang, Irsyad cuba mencuri hati Nuzul dengan mengajar Nuzul berenang di kolam. Selepas menghabiskan masa di kolam, Irsyad membawa Nuzul ke kondonya. Irsyad memperkenalkan sepupunya Caroline dan suaminya Alex pada Nuzul. Caroline adalah sepupu Irsyad yang mana gadis yang sama dijumpai Nuzul ketika di mall. Irsyad menjelaskan segalanya tentang Caroline dan Nuzul minta maaf kerana menuduh Irsyad yang bukan-bukan. Irsyad membawa Nuzul ke majlis makan malam di hotel mewakili Tan Sri Jefri Lee dan Puan Sri Ayuni yang tidak dapat menghadirkan diri.

programme.title: SLAM bersama MPO
programme.desc: Saksikan malam penuh nostalgia apabila Malaysian Philharmonic Orchestra bergabung dengan kumpulan popular 90-an, SLAM, dalam sebuah konsert istimewa di pentas DFP. Nikmati lagu-lagu hit era pop melankolik yang diolah dengan sentuhan orkestra penuh elegan, menyatukan keharmonian muzik simfoni dan energi bertenaga SLAM dalam kolaborasi luar biasa ini.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Harris mula menyedari perasaannya yang semakin mendalam terhadap Ameena, sementara Ameena pula terpaksa berdepan satu realiti baharu yang langsung tidak pernah dia jangkakan, sesuatu yang mengubah segalanya. Dalam masa yang sama, Maria sedar dia perlu bertindak lebih ekstrem jika benar-benar mahu menang.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Kesihatan maimun merosot akibat luka pada tapak kaki akibat terpijak kaca. Usop cuba bantu mana yang mampu. Maimun risau akan wok. Jika dia pergi, siapa yang akan menjaga wok. Bercadang untuk mencarikan jodoh untuk wok. Usop, dalam diam menaruh hati, namun ditolak mentah-mentah

programme.title: Pembancuh Kopi Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Nuzul mengambil peluang ini untuk merapatkan hubungannya dengan Irsyad. Pada suatu malam, Nuzul dan Irsyad bermain catur. Oleh kerana Nuzul menang, Irsyad dikehendaki untuk mengisi borang yang telah disediakan Nuzul. Di dalam borang tersebut tercatat soalan tentang nama bekas teman wanita Irsyad dan nama restoran kegemaran Irsyad. Nuzul mempunyai rancangan untuk memikat hati suaminya. Dia berkunjung ke setiap restoran mewah yang menjadi kegemaran Irsyad dan cuba mendapatkan resipi setiap makanan kegemaran suaminya melalui chef-chef di restoran berkenaan. Nuzul nekad melakukan apa saja demi mengelakkan Irsyad memadukannya dengan perempuan lain. Setelah berjaya mengumpul semua resipi, Nuzul pulang ke rumah. Namun dia terkejut dengan tengkingan Irsyad dan suaminya itu juga telah melempar fitnah bahawa Nuzul berlaku curang. Nuzul terkejut.

Dia berangan untuk cantik dan bergaya seperti Viva, dan bersembunyi di Instagram dengan nama samaran "Kylie".

programme.desc: Dengan bajet sebanyak RM2,000 sahaja,, pereka bentuk dalaman Janna Baha selaku pengacara akan menghias semula ruang bilik tidur milik Fatiha di sebuah Pangsapur di Seri Kembangan.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Zarif terpaksa berdepan dengan akibat daripada kesilapannya sendiri, manakala Maria pantas mengambil peluang untuk membalas. Ameena pula berpaut pada satu-satunya harapan yang ditinggalkan Zaidi, dan kali ini dia benar-benar tekad untuk menamatkan segalanya.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Ketika pulang dari berniaga sayuran, maimun dilanggar motor. Kecederaan kaki bertambah teruk. Doktor nasihatkan untuk memotong kaki supaya tidak merebak. Keesokkannya, usop datang menjenguk dan terkejut, maimun sudah di pondok usang mereka. Berbual melawak dan terbuka soal jodoh lagi untuk wok. Usop seloroh, dia boleh jagakan wok. Maimun pantas menolak. Usop senyum kelat.

programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Dato' Yusni Hamid berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.desc: Aiman menyedari makna sebenar cinta, bukan sekadar memiliki tetapi memahami.

programme.title: Rainy Night Flower
programme.desc: After leaving reformatory, Xin Xiong joins a gang to make a living and soon he becomes a leader of the gang. He takes protection fees from vendors and works hard to 'maintain the local order' in his way. He has thus developed a very good relationship with the law enforcement unit. Later, a teahouse owner Gui Zhu has fallen in love with Xin Xiong who loves Yue Gui. The triangle relationship is entangled with jealousy.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: In a small fishing village, Shun-Rong works tirelessly to support his wife and four children. When drought destroys their harvest and debts pile up, he is forced to take on extra fishing and even sell his own blood just to keep the family afloat. Despite hardship, he continues to face life with optimism, teaching his children resilience and hope as each of them grows toward their own future.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 1
programme.desc: Dua beradik berbeza perwatakan - Maria, anak kebanggaan keluarga yang cemerlang dalam pelajaran - manakala Mariana, anak yang sering memberontak dan liar. Maria membesar menjadi seorang anggota polis namun Mariana masih sama seperti dahulu. Persengketaan terjadi apabila keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Diculik geng, Maria sanggup menaruhkan nyawa demi menyelamatkan Mariana.

programme.title: Sepet
programme.desc: Sepasang kekasih melalui pelbagai halangan dalam percintaan kerana keduanya berasal dari latar belakang yang berbeza. Orked mencintai Jason yang berbangsa Cina dan bukan beragama Islam. Disebabkan itu pelbagai tekanan terpaksa mereka hadapi kerana stereotaip bangsa dan berlainan agama namun berjaya mereka hadapinya bersama-sama.

programme.title: Warna-Warna Hati
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita yang terpaksa menguruskan sebuat syarikat besar tanpa bantuan keluarganya. Perniagaan syarikat milik keluarga Puan Rohani mengalami pelbagai masalah selepas Encik Osman, pengurus syarikat tersebut terlibat dalam kes penyelewengan wang syarikat. Anak-anak Puan Rohani yang tidak berminat untuk membantu ibunya dan mengambil tahu mengenai syarikat tersebut menyebabkan Puan Rohani memberi kepercayaan kepada Encik Osman. Puan Rohani juga cuba memujuk anak lelakinya, Hafsham yang baru tamat pengajian dari Amerika Syarikat untuk bekerja di syarikat itu dan membantunya untuk menguruskan syarikat

programme.title: Sepi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tiga orang yang berasingan mengenal erti cinta, kehilangan dan kesepian. Adam, seorang tukang masak terkenal yang meluaskan kerjayanya dengan mereka hiasan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Tetapi, dengan segala kejayaan itu beliau masih membujang dan belum bertemu jodohnya sendiri. Sufi pula seorang lelaki yang sedang cuba melenyapkan memori kematian isterinya. Akhir sekali, Iman, seorang penulis muda yang menjadikan pentas teater sebagai tapak untuk memahami masa silamnya dan kupasan demi kupasan ke dalam masa depannya sendiri. Ketiga-tiga watak ini akhirnya terkait dalam satu insiden dramatik yang akan merubah kehidupan mereka buat selamanya.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 2
programme.desc: Maria dikejarkan ke hospital dan menemui cinta bersama doktor yang menyelamatkannya. Kemudiannya, dia ditugaskan untuk membanteras sindiket pengedaran dadah. Hubungan Maria dan Mariana kembali tegang apabila bekas kekasih Mariana muncul kembali. Cara hidup liar Mariana menyebabkan dia diperalatkan dan menimbulkan kekacauan dalam hidup mereka.

programme.title: SH3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. Sikap setiakawan dan keluarga menjadi penyokong kuat Khairul untuk berjaya.

programme.title: Gemilang
programme.desc: Julia merupakan seorang penyanyi yang mencapai kejayaan di atas sokongan seorang hartawan bernama Razlan. Rita, teman baik Julia pula merupakan seorang artis terkenal dan menganggap Julia sebagai sumber inspirasinya. Julia merasakan keselamatan dirinya terancam apabila gerak-gerinya sering diawasi oleh seorang lelaki misteri.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Imperial Coroner, The (II) & What's On Today
programme.desc: The story of the aloof Prince An, Xiao Jinyu, and Chu Chu, the imperial-appointed female coroner, after their marriage! Their careers, relationships, and overall perspectives are all upgraded. Together with the youth team of the Three Judicial Offices, they uncover the truth and solve bizarre cases, working hand in hand to safeguard the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

programme.title: Road Trip Down Under
programme.desc: Two groups of celebrity friends embarked on a unique road trip adventure in Australia, showcasing their genuine interactions. Wayne Lai, Edwin Siu, and Raymond Cho, who forged an unbreakable friendship over a decade ago on the set of the TV series "The Confidant" reunited for another memorable journey. The three brothers explored stunning scenery, experienced local culture, and shared heartfelt conversations about their careers and families. Karl Ting, Jinny Ng, and Joey Thye, known as best friends in the entertainment industry, traveled together to Queensland and other destinations, combining work with leisure. The friends shared beautiful natural landscapes, diverse food and entertainment, and sparked hilarious moments!

programme.title: Food Mister
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what fictional dishes in literature would taste like? The flavors of the food described by authors are left to the reader's interpretation; however, it's not entirely impossible to cook them in reality. The host invites celebrity chefs to find creative inspiration from TV series, video games, cartoons, and literary classics, discovering some of the featured dishes mentioned within them, and then, through the skillful hands of these master chefs, "recreating" these seemingly unreal dishes. Can these fantastical dishes actually be cooked? Or are they merely the creators' fantasies? The program immerses viewers in a culinary world where fantasy and reality intertwine!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Gourmet Express & What's On Today
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: Some dope called Powder Gremlin is everywhere in the city. Undercover cop Poon Yik-fung (Mark Ma) has been mingling with wise guys and eventually brings narcotic chemist Kuen Sai-ho to justice, but the crook only receives a lenient sentence! Yik-fung asks his boss to consider extending the undercover operation with permission to recruit a contingent of undercover policewomen, and the aim is to investigate the mysterious mastermind behind Sai-ho's scheme. Yik-fung selects three pretty female decoys, each with their unique talents: Shum Kai-kei (Kelly Cheung), aka Female Sherlock Holmes; Kong Miu-chi (Jeannie Chan), aka Meticulous and Sharp-witted Martial Arts Expert; and Tung Siu-yue (Yuki Law), aka Ever-changing Walking Encyclopedia. They have to get close to philanthropic businessman Lau Biu (Eddie Kwan) and his wife Bonnie Ka (Maggie Shiu), and the only obstacle is their daughter Lau Po-yee (Yumi Chung). However, Yik-fung has some hidden agenda as he pushes the female decoys to carry out risky tasks.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: Seasoned Chinese frog closure instructor Kwok-Law Mei-lan (Paw Hee Ching) has raised her children and grandchildren by herself. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Big Big Home
programme.desc: New buildings are glamorous and stylish, saving you a lot of decorating hassles. Older homes, with a little thought, can also be given a fresh new look. Host Tan Kaiying travels throughout Taiwan, delving into prime urban locations and emerging towns with development potential, exploring impressive luxury villas and unique homes in "The Big Dreamer"! How do Hong Kong residents who have moved to Taiwan realize their dreams of homeownership and entrepreneurship? Several "dreamers" share their local property buying stories and lifestyle guides. Director Lai Fengqi, Taiwanese-American singer Rong Zhonghao, artist Yang Zili, music producer Chen Hongjia, and Liu Lixue, the "father of Chinese computers" from Canada, will also reveal their comfortable homes on the show.

programme.title: Profession Impossible
programme.desc: To showcase the talents of local fashion designers, TVB specially produced a fashion design competition reality show. Ten contestants advanced from the preliminary rounds to the semi-finals, each designing two pieces for their collaborating artists based on environmental and Chinese themes, competing for five spots in the finals. The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

programme.title: Romance of A Twin Flower
programme.desc: Ji Man, who grew up in Haifang, lost her memory after falling into the water and unexpectedly became the wife of Ning Yuxuan, the Left Minister of the Imperial Court. Upon awakening, Ji Man learned she was the universally hated First Lady of the Marquis's mansion. Hoping to win Ning Yuxuan's favor, she was instead ruthlessly banished to the Repentance Pavilion. Ji Man turned her fortunes around in the Marquis's mansion by selling "Scar-Removing Cream," and later saved her husband before the Emperor, winning his favor and being granted the title of Second-Rank Imperial Lady. Ning Yuxuan brought Ji Man to Haifang to take up his post. Together, they defeated the two villains who ruled Haifang, Shen Liancheng and Wang Jinyao. Under Ning Yuxuan's governance, Haifang took on a new look, and Ji Man also opened a cosmetics shop, Haoxuetang. With the holding of the Imperial Merchants Conference, various forces vied for power, and conspiracies unfolded. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man joined forces to defeat Prince Tan. Unexpectedly, Ji Man fell off a cliff, and Ning Yuxuan searched for her in vain, falling into a long period of longing. A year later, Haifang was hit by a flood. Ning Yuxuan and Ji Man reunited during the disaster relief efforts. After overcoming numerous hardships, they finally became a couple...

programme.title: Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: “Sheung's Silver Chamber”, the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM's family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG's younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM's family. Fueled by hatred, CHING SAU-HANG (Ng Wing Mei), WAN's lover, marries HANG and ironically becomes WAN's sister-in-law. WAN falls out with HANG, and opts to live abroad and disconnects from his family. After leaving home for years, WAN does not return home until the occasion to celebrate his father's birthday. Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long's two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei's (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love. The two sisters have found the right guys. Tsz-long and Hoi-kei never miss any job opportunity as they want to have their own love nest. The couple move into a 100-square-foot plus subdivided unit after getting married. They not only have to deal with daily inconveniences due to insufficient space but also need to handle emotional issues of their aging parents on both sides.

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases. His brother-in-law CHOW SUN-YUNG (Ben Wong), one of the CCB inspectors, is determined to put him in jail, collaborating with superior HO SHEUNG-YEE (Sharon Chan) and subordinate CHI NGA (Kate Tsui) to gather evidence. SUN-YUNG thinks highly of CHI NGA and even regards her as his last apprentice, to his surprise, CHI NGA suddenly resigns and starts working for CHEUK YUK.

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that “knowledge is power”. He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING's further studies on computer sciences in America. The two brothers return to Hong Kong eventually and they work in the same commercial building. CHING works as a senior network security engineer while MING works as a junior security guard. MAN worries that the difference in their job ranking will hinder their relationship. MING admires a girl YUEN WAI CHUNG (Kwok Sonija) who opens a paper mud figure shop. MAN tries to help MING establish his career by buying a secondhand bookshop for him to operate. However, MAN doesn't realize that the virtual world is gradually manipulating his family. CHING meets a romanticist TSU HEI MAN (Yeo Vivien) at work which creates misunderstanding between him and his girlfriend, LUI YUEN YI (Yeung Shirley). MAN's younger daughter FONG SUM MEI (Ho Lily) indulges herself in the virtual world and she is suspected for stealing exam papers on the internet…

programme.title: Conquest, The
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered. More than history, The Conquest is a vivid portrayal of the prominent historical figures of 2,500 years ago. Although they do not seem to belong to the world of today, their endurance and courage in the face of adversity will never go out of date.
